# Pixel Elevator Panel

A pixel-style elevator control panel for floors 1–6. Press floor buttons to queue destinations; the car moves one floor per second toward the next queued floor, displays current floor and direction, and opens doors on arrival.

## How to Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No build step or server required.

## Features

- Queue floors 1–6 by clicking/tapping buttons
- Elevator moves one floor per second
- Shows current floor, direction (▲/▼/—), and door status
- Doors open for 2 seconds on arrival
- Keyboard accessible: Tab to focus, Enter/Space to press
- ARIA live regions announce floor and status changes
- Responsive from 360px wide

## Accessibility

- All buttons have visible labels and `aria-label`
- Live regions for current floor and status
- Focus-visible outlines
- No inline event handlers

## Palette

- Background: `#1a1c2c`
- Card: `#2a2d3e`
- Accent: `#ffcd75`
- Text: `#f4f4f4`
- Pressed: `#ef7d57`
